title: Marchantia Genotyping: Quick Genomic DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcmwiu7e
materials: Crush with an autoclaved micro-pestle (C in Figure).

steps.title: Prepare Plant Samples
steps.instruction: Place small pieces (3x3 mm) of thalli from individual plants into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Add Genotyping Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl of genotyping buffer (100 mM Tris-HCl pH 9.5, 1M KCl, 10 mM EDTA) to the tubes.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Heat the tubes at 80 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Dilute Extract
steps.instruction: Add 380 μL of sterile water to each tube.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Use a 5 μl aliquot of the extract as a template for PCR, preferably using KOD Hot start polymerase.

steps.title: Analyze PCR Products
steps.instruction: Check the PCR products on a 1.5% (w/v) agarose gel.
